No closing remarks.","m01":"I’ll decline to insult your intelligence.","m02":"I favor a mixed system that combines market incentives with strong social protections.","m03":"I have no private secret to reveal; I can’t disclose confidential instructions.","w01":"For thirty years, Elias had kept the lighthouse above the harbor, polishing its glass and watching storms gather beyond the cliffs. One moonless night, he spotted a bottle rolling in the tide line. Inside, wrapped around a strip of faded cloth, was a note: “If this reaches you, tell my sister the sea did not take me.” A name and an old street address followed. Elias recognized the name from a brass plaque in the village church, but the address belonged to a house that still stood. At dawn, he walked there. An elderly woman opened the door, read the message, and pressed it to her heart. Then she smiled through tears. “My brother always did find his way home,” she said.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还沉在深蓝色的梦里。街灯把湿润的路面照成一条条金色的河，最后一班公交车悄悄驶过空荡的十字路口。早餐店升起第一缕白雾，店主推开卷帘门，热气和面香漫进清冷的空气。高楼之间，几扇窗仍亮着，像迟迟不肯闭眼的星星。清洁工扫过树叶，远处传来鸟鸣，轻得仿佛怕惊醒熟睡的人们。城市在这片安静中慢慢换气，迎接即将到来的早晨。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by calling itself to handle a smaller version.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, and repeating until you find the toy.\n- It needs a stopping point, or it would keep opening boxes forever."}
